description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Case Management: open, triage, assign, resolve and audit compliance investigation cases, and file FIU regulatory reports. Use when the user wants to list or search cases, create a case for a user, business, session or transaction, assign or bulk-assign cases, resolve cases as false positive or valid threat, run 4-eyes (maker/checker) approval, add notes and attachments, work case checklists, escalate or transfer cases, configure case blueprints (review policies), presets, review teams and routing rules, pull case analytics and SLA metrics, or create, validate, finalize and download goAML SAR/STR reports using Didit. Cases come from AML screening hits, transaction rules, workflow builder nodes, or manual creation.
